emptyMineBody: A set is a deck of cards with a term on one side and a definition on the other. Type them, paste them from a spreadsheet, or have AI draft them from your notes.
emptyStarredBody: Star a set to keep it close at hand.
emptyStudiedBody: Sets you study will show up here with your progress.
emptyRecentBody: Sets you open will be listed here.
visibilityPrivateHint: Only you can open this set.
visibilityUnlistedHint: Anyone you send the link to can study it. It won't appear in search.
visibilityPublicHint: Anyone can find and study this set.
progressGuest: Sign up to save your progress and see it fill in here.
noStarredTerms: You haven't starred any terms. Tap the star next to a term you find difficult.
sharePrivateNote: This set is private, so the link only works for you. Change who can see it to share it.
emptyCardsTitle: This set has no cards yet
emptyCardsBody: Add terms and definitions to start studying.
notEnoughCards: Add at least {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} to use this mode.
signUpToSave: Sign up free to save your progress
homeEmptyBody: Type a few terms, or paste a whole list from a spreadsheet. You can be studying in under a minute.
downloaded: Saved on this device. You can study it without a connection.
downloadFailed: Couldn't save the set for offline use. Check your connection and storage space.
offlinePremium: Downloading sets for offline use is part of Premium. Sets you've opened recently still work offline.
